scope.contractInvocation: 7.1 limits preparation instructions to the data product generated by the discrete contract task.
scope.testingContexts: 7.2 names engineering(developmental), preliminary qualification, qualification, and acceptance testing; requirements are not duplicated by context.
scope.dataOnly: Reporting results, procedures used, calibration status, conclusions and proposed actions does not create independent testing, calibration, redesign, corrective-work or acceptance duties.

granularity.rule: One underlying data obligation per coherent content list/statement or distinct authentication duty; no one-record-per-field or one-record-per-test-type multiplication.
granularity.parentReuse: 10.2,10.2.3,10.2.6 and10.2.7 parents are quoted with child spans where needed; no additional records merely repeat the general section shall.
granularity.resultsDiscussion: The explicit10.2.6.4.2d shall concerning design-requirement versus tested-configuration discrepancies is fully preserved in the grouped results-discussion record, without a duplicate count.
granularity.modals: Every feed-data shall and each inherited content list was covered; no must or explicit feed-data prohibition appears. 10.1 format permission/organizing instruction is a contract field fact rather than an invented literal-shall record.

formatCadenceFacts.passage: Contractor format is acceptable. Organize the information required by paragraph 10.2 and its subparagraphs in a manner that facilitates presentation and understanding
formatCadenceFacts.fact: Contractor format is allowed. No required file extension, JSON/XML/CSV schema, Word version, or electronic-signature encoding is established. Any machine feed representation is a selected contract format, not a government-mandated native schema.

formatCadenceFacts.passage:
The test/inspection report shall contain the following information, as applicable.

The following certifications shall be included, as applicable:
formatCadenceFacts.fact: Content and certification applicability is conditional. Do not require all three authentication branches for every result row without evaluating applicability.

formatCadenceFacts.passage:
a. Report date.

g. Date or period of test/inspection.
formatCadenceFacts.fact: Report date and test/inspection date or period are required content as applicable; the DID does not prescribe a date-string encoding.
No periodic delivery cadence or fixed elapsed-time deadline is stated. Delivery timing must come from the actual contract/CDRL; do not invent monthly, quarterly, or event-plus-days deadlines.

formatCadenceFacts.passage:
Complete identification of the test/inspection requirements correlated to contractual requirements including the following:
a. Required test/inspection parameters.
b. Performance requirements, acceptance or compliance limits, and environmental criteria.
formatCadenceFacts.fact: Contractual-requirement correlation is explicit. A WBS join, requirementId field name or database identifier syntax is not native to this DID; any required receiving-feed trace keys must be identified as the user-selected contract choice.

formatCadenceFacts.passage: a. Matrices comparing results achieved against test/inspection objectives or requirements.
formatCadenceFacts.fact: Evidence includes achieved-result comparison against objectives or requirements. Preserve the actual acceptance/compliance limits and observed results; no invented universal pass/fail formula.

Three distinct as-applicable certifications: results truth/conformance, prior validation of requirements not retested/measured with data and method, and item acceptability(pass or fail). Performer signatures are specified only for results certification; authorized contractor representative and any Government witness apply to the applicable certification. And is cumulative, not an OR alternative.

Extensive recorded data goes in an appendix; appendices also hold material too voluminous for the main body, referenced documents not previously Government-provided, and associated-activity reports as specified. An individual evidence row is not a complete report, title page, contents index, authentication package or appendix set.

notes: Operative only when invoked by the actual contract and within the source applicability conditions. The 22 records group coherent content duties and distinct authentication duties; product/test contexts are applicability metadata, not duplicate obligations. All normalized records remain sample paraphrases awaiting review.
